title: Tax preparers: 3 things to renew before *filing season*

items.title: Your PTIN. It expires *Dec 31*.
items.body: Every year. Renew it now, before January gets loud.

items.title: License or CE hours
items.body: If your state or credential requires them, check the deadline today.

items.title: Your E&O policy
items.body: Know the renewal date before 60-hour weeks start.

cta.title: Deadlines are your job. Your *own* shouldn't be.
cta.body: CertTrack tracks expiration dates and alerts you before they expire.
